title: Mystical Legends
notes: Summarized from the author’s supplied series outline. Dates are relative unless specified. Empty arc headings are not expanded into invented events. Book XIII is absent from the source; Books XIX–XXI are tentative continuations. Historical time-travel events are grouped by narrative journey rather than presented as fixed calendar dates.

timeline.era: Zenith Luces — Before the Main Series
timeline.date: Past eras; includes travel across fractured time
timeline.title: Journey of the Mystical Beings
timeline.summary: Zenith’s journey revolves around an artifact ring, the founding of the Mystical Island, and repeated confrontations with Lordius Doomolo across fractured realities.

events.title: The Original Banishment
events.description: An Angelor uses an artifact ring to banish Lordius Doomolo and Tomolock into a fractured reality between the spirit and shadow realms. They escape weakened hundreds of years later, during the Journey of the Mystical Beings.

events.title: The Sustination Orb
events.description: After the island’s founding, the weakened Doomolo obtains the Sustination Orb and threatens the island. He is defeated and flees.

events.title: Tomolock’s Artifact Search
events.description: Tomolock escapes the fractured reality, obtains William’s map, and travels to another island in search of the ring that imprisoned him.

events.title: The Battle Across Time
events.description: A struggle over the artifact sends Zenith, Caela, Pyrus, Doomolo, and Tomolock into fractured reality. They emerge more than ninety years later, roughly sixteen years before the main story, and continue their battle.
events.date: Roughly sixteen years before Book I

events.title: Zenith’s Return to the Past
events.description: Zenith takes Doomolo back into fractured reality and learns to regress his enemy’s powers. Both are displaced to a time before the Journey and separated. Zenith discovers that his presence helps inspire Caela to begin that very journey.

events.title: The Ring’s Protector
events.description: Zenith defeats Doomolo in a final battle and prepares a new district to protect the ring. The return to this earlier moment is made possible by outside intervention from the past: ancestors create fractures into their future, rather than into their past.

timeline.date: Before Kaden’s life in New York
timeline.title: The Fall of District 1
timeline.summary: Ioward Icelander’s attempt to revive his wife destroys District 1, while Kaden’s first IT Agency fights Malum and leaves behind the Nuntios’ mission to protect others.

events.title: Ioward’s Pact
events.description: District 1’s progenitor, Ioward Icelander, becomes the vessel of a powerful member of the twelve Demon Gods to revive his late wife. Soul harvesting raises him from Ultimus Deus to Celestius Deus and grants immortality.

events.title: Malum and the First IT Agency
events.description: Master Malum undermines the IT model established by Ioward and Kaden. Kaden gathers the Nuntios into the first IT Agency to resist the company, unaware that Ioward secretly hired Malum to destroy both his legacy and District 1.

events.title: The Failed Revival
events.description: Despite Kaden and the Nuntios’ intervention, the bomb destroys District 1 and leaves few survivors. The revival ritual fails; the Demon God gains an independent body and abandons Ioward. Ioward and Kaden leave for New York.

events.title: The Nuntios’ New Purpose
events.description: Kaden releases the Nuntios from his service and asks them to prevent similar tragedies. Josh Picard, Jay Neomo, Lux Luces, and Marin Kne train at Regnum Academy until the four can undertake S+ missions together.

timeline.title: Rune of the Spellcaster
timeline.summary: Avery discovers his Angelor identity, enters mystical schooling, and faces Pyrus Bourn’s invasion as the Rune of the Spellcaster and Orb of Destruction reshape his future.

events.title: OSNYC Admission
events.description: Former street boy Avery Obtainia learns about Mystical Beings and his Angelor heritage at the mainland school OSNYC. He meets Teddric Tech and River Grant during admission, while magical species, basic magic, and rankings are introduced.

events.title: The Cabin and the Ancient Rune
events.description: Avery discovers a cabin holding the Rune of the Spellcaster. A fragment of Doomolo’s power reveals a vision of Caela Obtainia, Zenith Luces, and the sealing of the Orb of Destruction. Avery first uses healing magic.

events.title: Kaden and the Shadow Cult
events.description: IT manager Kaden Icelander demonstrates ice magic and Ice Travel. A shadow cult encounter leads to an ATLAS meeting about the incident and student placement, involving Jim Jaedin and Marx Sumaho.

events.title: Regnum Academy Start
events.description: The students travel to District 7, Lux Urbis, and begin at Regnum Academy. Elmor Locks, Jane Tee, Ken and Kirk Masumi, and Charlotte Levy enter the story; cohorts, the Three Symbols, and magical discharge are introduced.

events.title: Invasion by Fire
events.description: Pyrus crashes into District 7’s town hall and awakens as a Larvan wielding inferno magic. Contact with the Orb reveals Avery’s wings and strengthens his magic, while Kaden shows the Icelorian Blade and other defenders reveal further affinities.

events.title: The Mystical Legends’ Promise
events.description: Oceanus Aquia appears in the aftermath. Regnum Spei and Avery’s Compression are revealed, and the concept of the Mystical Legends takes shape. Avery and River vow to pursue equality between commoners and nobles.

timeline.title: The I.T.E.R. Chronicles — Initialization
timeline.summary: Cohort competition and an IT internship establish the next stage of the students’ training and their ties to Kaden’s work.

events.title: Cohort Clash
events.description: Additional cohort captains, including Cedric Paine, Len Hiyama, and Carla Storm, are introduced.

events.title: Flag Game and IT Internship
events.description: The outline names the Flag Game and IT Internship arcs. Later notes establish that Avery and Teddric earn prize money from the flag game; further details of these arcs are not yet supplied.

timeline.date: Following Initialization; includes Kaden’s earlier life
timeline.title: The I.T.E.R. Chronicles — Rectification
timeline.summary: Stolen robot blueprints, demihuman kidnappings, and political manipulation force Kaden and his allies into hiding as Lux Urbis approaches a three-faction conflict.

events.title: Kaden’s Past and the Cohort Selections
events.description: At fourteen, one year after District 1’s fall, Kaden is withdrawn in New York until new friends inspire him to act. Later, the group of seven undergoes cohort selection; sixteen-year-old Kaden remains a second-year Blue Legion student and Avery joins Tempest Aquia.

events.title: Kidnappings and Council Schemes
events.description: River is captured for forced labor producing illicit I.T.E.R. parts. Noble Thelio denies the evidence with Hayman’s backing, while Hayman secretly supports the kidnappings and manipulates the council against Kaden. Council discussions also foreshadow an army gathering in the north, District 6, and Imperium.

events.title: The Robot Outbreak
events.description: A longtime IT employee steals the I.T.E.R. blueprints and unleashes duplicate robots to frame the company. The heroes’ auction trip is interrupted by the outbreak; police and council officials converge on IT, and Martin identifies Kaden as the project’s creator.

events.title: Fugitives and the Dark Market
events.description: Kaden, Lucy, Avery, and their allies escape IT Tower and are declared S-ranked fugitives. Pursued through nomadic forest land, they reach District 13’s black market to trace a captured robot’s network and identify its source.

events.title: The Slum Factory and Three Factions
events.description: Anger over demihuman exploitation escalates into fighting at Lux Urbis’s gates as robots defend the city they previously attacked. The heroes uncover a forced-labor factory; a defeated deputy identifies Morphius as its boss.

events.title: After the I.T.E.R. Conflict
events.description: The seven pursue intensive training to reach the next tier before school resumes, while the Masumi brothers disappear elsewhere. River encounters Josh Picard, who rescues her from trouble.

timeline.date: The next semester and preparations for the festival
timeline.title: Aqua Revolution
timeline.summary: The Nuntios return, the Aquia family’s history emerges, and a water-kingdom conflict leads into reforms at Regnum and preparations for the school festival.

events.title: Nuntios’ Return and Winter’s Dance
events.description: Josh, Jay, Lux, and Marin take teaching roles at Regnum. Kiara Katzol and Imo Lordius transfer in. At the mandatory Winter’s Dance, River stays out of the festivities and Atlas confronts her.

events.title: The Atalantia Investigation
events.description: Avery discovers he can breathe underwater. Atlas, Alteria, and Avery are commissioned to address an urgent issue in the water kingdom, where investigations connect Atalantia, Malum, and Mas Rellim to District 1’s destruction and later conflicts.

events.title: River’s Family History
events.description: Atalantia adopted River alongside her biological children, Atlas and Alteria. River fled after her adoptive father was captured and killed during a failed secret arrangement involving citizen trafficking and a demanded marriage alliance. Atlas’s investigation exposes the family’s concealed dealings, though both siblings continue to blame River before confronting their own wrongs.

events.title: The Attack on the Water Kingdom
events.description: Atalantia diverts Mas Rellim’s water weapons to defend her kingdom. Hidden interference, including the Whale Lord’s influence, is suspected. Atlas and Alteria acknowledge their failings, advance in rank, and fight together against Mas Rellim.

events.title: Homerooms, Familiars, and the Pre-Festival
events.description: Regnum introduces homeroom groups to curb noble influence and formally teaches familiars and spiritual bonds. Second-years perform a lifelong familiar ritual. Cohort missions and a pre-festival tournament test the students, with resources and rank-enhancing alchemy pills among the prizes. Billy Bones Acitas is fully introduced as Red Shred’s captain.

timeline.title: Festival Saga
timeline.summary: Regnum’s celebrations and competitions are interrupted by the Hands of Doom, Imo’s defection, and renewed struggles over magical orbs.

events.title: The Regnum Festival
events.description: A large tournament, alchemy and runecrafting contests, entertainment, and elective competitions bring the cohorts and elite students together. The outline also names Beast Hunt and Advancements arcs without further details.

events.title: The Festival Raid and Imo’s Choice
events.description: The first two Hands of Doom appear to sow chaos and conduct a search. Alienated from his classmates and persuaded by his family’s ambitions, Imo Lordius joins the Hands of Doom and leaves Regnum.

events.title: The Earth Orb and Pyrus’s Escape
events.description: A battle over the earth orb begins during the festival. Pyrus accepts aid from shadow cultists to escape prison while pursuing his own aims, and the Magni Mage personally confronts an invader.

events.title: The Aquia Estate
events.description: With no home for summer, Avery reluctantly accepts work at the Aquia Estate as Alteria’s servant, revealing the estate more fully.

timeline.title: Red Showdown
timeline.summary: District unrest, Pyrus’s return, and rising shadow threats shape school rivalries, mainland internships, and Red Shred’s efforts to restore stability.

events.title: District 3 Recapture
events.description: Pyrus retakes District 3 without openly opposing District 7. A truce redirects attention toward the shadow cult, whose attempt to seize the orb unsettles the districts’ balance of power.

events.title: Trading Town and New York Internship
events.description: Diplomatic transfers intensify competition among incoming students. Avery and others return to OSNYC as IT Agency interns supporting Mystical Surveillance Units.

events.title: Red Shred’s Response
events.description: Billy Bones Acitas and the cohorts suppress rising danger after the festival attack. His cohort band performs around Lux Urbis to lift morale, with Avery’s group assisting despite continuing distrust and tension.

events.title: School Selection and Council Quarantine
events.description: The biannual competition among Regnum, Magis, and Imperium brings the rival schools into focus. Avery and Teddric are assigned to work directly under council members.

timeline.title: The Rogue God
timeline.summary: A surviving deity targets those blessed by the gods, while Kaden restores District 1 and the graduating Mystical Legends choose their separate paths.

events.title: Deity Encirclement
events.description: A millennia-old Rogue God, sustained by a secondary mana catalyst, directs followers to find deities and seize their power. Avery, who holds Lynnhera, becomes a target as the twelve deities are introduced.

events.title: Avery and Kiara’s Capture
events.description: The group captures Avery and Kiara and attempts to extract their deities. Lynnhera’s integration with Avery prevents ordinary extraction, so his captors instead seek his catalyst.

events.title: District 1 Rekindling
events.description: The deity followers seek shadow energy in District 1 to continue their ritual. Kaden uses the opportunity to retake the district; Avery and their allies help cleanse it. Citizens return and Kaden becomes the new Magni Sage.

events.title: Graduation and Separate Paths
events.description: The students complete their final graduation test with high marks. Kaden joins Avery and the others as they leave school and pursue individual paths to grow stronger against the shadows.

timeline.date: A few weeks after the group separates
timeline.title: The Faraway Paladin
timeline.summary: A shadowy island leads Avery’s companions into the history of the deities and their war against Demon Lord Bathybius Dion.

events.title: The Unmarked Island
events.description: Some of the separated Mystical Legends arrive on a shadowy island rumored to have been discovered by Zenith Luces. Trisdain Leonard and the rulers’ black knights enter the story.

events.title: The Lady of the Lake
events.description: Lynnhera awakens and guides Avery and his companions to Artiana, the Lady of the Lake. The deities’ war against Bathybius Dion is explained, along with their continuing influence on history. The Leaf Series arc remains undeveloped in these notes.

timeline.title: Shadow Dwelling
timeline.summary: Avery’s reunion with his allies coincides with marriage-alliance tensions and Doomolo’s full revival as shadow-realm experiments threaten the world.

events.title: District 12 and the Wedding Alliance
events.description: Avery meets Lumen and helps repel two Hands of Doom attacking District 12. Lumen proposes an alliance with District 10 through marriage, but Lux refuses; Kiara and Prince Aether are involved, and Avery later protects Lux.

events.title: Reunion and the Mainland Laboratory
events.description: The outline names Reunion and Mainland Laboratory arcs as part of the renewed struggle against the shadow cult, without supplying their full events.

events.title: Doomolo’s Revival
events.description: Lordius Doomolo revives using Luo Ye’s immortal blood and escapes fractured reality. Venjolo’s shadow-realm experiments support his plan to expose magic, raise ambient magical density through rifts, and unleash shadow soldiers and spiritless entities such as a revived Mas Rellim.

timeline.title: Districts’ Unition
timeline.summary: The heroes work to unite the districts against Doomolo, resolving local conflicts to win the trust of their Magni.

events.title: The First District Union
events.description: Districts 1, 5, 7, and 12 begin discussing a united response to Doomolo and his army.

events.title: Winning the Other Districts
events.description: The heroes journey through the other districts to resolve disputes and gain each Magni’s support. Named arcs include Throneless Silvastra, District 3’s Silence, District 6 Split, District 8 Capture, and Pre-War Confrontation; their detailed outcomes are not supplied.

timeline.title: Mystic War
timeline.summary: The outlined war brings Doomolo’s assault, the districts’ rally, mounting casualties, and a climactic confrontation leading into world revelation.

events.title: From Confrontation to War
events.description: Pre-War Confrontation continues into Doom’s Assault and Districts Rally, bringing the unified districts into the central conflict. Detailed battles are not yet described.

events.title: The War’s Climax
events.description: Mystic War Peak, War Casualty, Battle Against Doom, and War Climax are listed as major stages. World Revelation begins at the end of this book; specific outcomes remain unspecified.

timeline.title: World Revelation
timeline.summary: Magic becomes widespread, society faces new dangers, and Avery’s relationship with Lynnhera develops into a struggle over his body and identity.

events.title: Mystical Convergence and Global Revelation
events.description: The revelation of magic continues. Increased magical density brings more creatures and greater magical capabilities, while a current Magni’s death signals a turning point. Beasts become sources of cultivation and rare materials, and rising crime creates a need for a national response.

events.title: Rising of the Saints
events.description: Lynnhera’s past and the lives of the deities are explored. Avery accepts her account and follows her advice as her influence on his life deepens.

events.title: Against the Gods
events.description: Lynnhera manifests as a living deity through Avery, transforms him into mana, and absorbs him, using the Spellcaster Seal Ring to reform her crown. His friends defeat her before greater harm occurs, but Avery does not fully awaken; she remains in control under the concealed identity Morgen.

events.title: The Angelor Betrayal and Holy War Prelude
events.description: An Angelor girl who had become close to Avery betrays him, contributing to the Angelors’ later return. Lynnhera’s ulterior motives partly align with those of the foreign Angelors as the Holy War approaches.

timeline.title: Angelos’ Retribution
timeline.summary: The return of the exiled Angelors brings a campaign to restrict magic to the worthy while Avery struggles to regain consciousness.

events.title: The Angelors’ Exile
events.description: In the past, Doomolo devastated the Angelor clan and forced its survivors to retreat from Earth. They remained trapped at the sun because travel required abundant magic at both ends of the route.

events.title: The Holy War
events.description: Rising magic on Earth enables the Angelors to break their seal and open a portal back. They seek to fulfill the first Demon Lord’s wish to remove magic from those deemed unworthy and establish a world guided by chosen Mystical Beings.

events.title: Avery Awakens
events.description: Lynnhera controls Avery through much of this period. By the book’s end, Avery regains consciousness but remains in Hera’s body.

timeline.date: After Angelos’ Retribution; Book XIII is not specified in the notes
timeline.title: The Reign of Magni
timeline.summary: Important marriages and succession trials establish the next generation of district leaders.

events.title: The Marriage Arc
events.description: Planned weddings include Avery and Lux, and Teddric and Jane. Kaden’s partner and other pairings are left unspecified.

events.title: The Magni Trials
events.description: Ultimus Deus candidates compete to succeed the current Magni, and the districts’ new leaders are declared.

timeline.title: Inheritance
timeline.summary: Robin Obtainia and Ava Icelander become the focus as a new generation begins its journey at Regnum.

events.title: New Regnum
events.description: Robin and Ava enroll in Regnum Academy’s middle school with new friends. Games, competition, and the start of cultivation give way to unexplained trouble.

timeline.title: Regnum Legends
timeline.summary: A major Regnum competition seeks the seven students who will represent the school’s future.

events.title: The Next Mystical Legends
events.description: Regnum Academy holds a grand competition to choose its next seven bright stars.

timeline.date: As global magic continues to increase
timeline.title: Fractured Reality
timeline.summary: Shadow gates and immortal demons force the heroes to seek Seal Rings capable of altering space and reality.

events.title: Chaos Emergence
events.description: The balance between creation and destruction comes into focus, alongside the Demon Lord’s past and the mysterious scepter known as the Judger.

events.title: The Shadow Gates
events.description: Rising magic allows the shadow and physical realms to connect through gates. Magical defenders are tasked with containing beasts whose strength depends on each gate’s intensity.

events.title: The Demon Threat
events.description: High-ranking immortal demonic beings in the shadow realm seek entry into Earth, with strength described as rank ten or higher.

events.title: Seal Hunt and Activation
events.description: The heroes seek Seal Rings and their wielders to bend space and reality against the demons. The Augment Ring is identified as particularly important.

timeline.title: From That Day
timeline.summary: Despite the Seal Rings, twelve demons emerge on Earth, prompting the Mystical Legends and their allies to pursue Celestius Deus and prepare for a final war.

events.title: The Heirs of Gods
events.description: Seal Activation continues, and the truth of the zodiac pagoda array is revealed and put to use.

events.title: The Twelve Demons Emerge
events.description: The group’s defense ultimately fails and all twelve demons establish themselves on Earth. Avery and his allies continue cultivating toward Celestius Deus, a previously unknown tier rumored to grant immortality.

events.title: Demon War Finale
events.description: The demons’ pursuit of immortality and its cost are unveiled. Deities, the Mystical Legends, and their allies join a final offensive into demon-held territory with the world’s survival at stake. The notes do not specify the final outcome.

timeline.date: Possible future; a few months after the demon war
timeline.title: Immortal Hunts
timeline.summary: Tentative: normalized gates become resources while public fear of the heroes’ immortal power fractures their lives and shifts the focus to Robin and Ava.

events.title: The Immortal Hunts
events.description: Gates serve as sources of cultivation, materials, and training. News of the group’s immortal ascension raises fears of their world-shaking power, beginning the immortal hunts; some companions are corrupted by power.

events.title: The Families Left Behind
events.description: Avery leaves to protect his family, and the story turns to Robin and Ava after their parents depart. The immortals ultimately pledge to defend the world independently of any single group, with Avery and Kaden retaining their Magni titles beyond District 7.

timeline.date: Possible future; Robin and Ava’s teenage years
timeline.title: Subzero
timeline.summary: Tentative: stronger shadow creatures and a catastrophic sea threat draw Robin and Ava into expeditions to the world’s coldest regions.

events.title: The Sea Creature Threat
events.description: Shadow monsters become stronger and influence other creatures beyond Tier 8. A massive sea creature rises to threaten catastrophic destruction, prompting a task force.

events.title: The Subzero Expedition
events.description: With magic commonplace and peace fragile, exploration reaches remote frozen regions. Teenage Robin and Ava sneak into an exclusive expedition team in search of adventure.

timeline.title: Deep Space
timeline.summary: Tentative: an era of magical technology and international peace opens the way to interstellar exploration and settlement.

events.title: Magic Beyond Earth
events.description: Countries and districts retain their governments under an aligned peace agreement. Advances led by IT use magic to overcome gravity, mass, and the limits of space travel, developing faster-than-light devices and wormholes.

events.title: Galactic Settlement
events.description: Humanity spreads across hundreds of celestial bodies. Advanced cultivation and magic support life beyond Earth, including survival in space.
